messages.subject: How to use FIRMA
parts:
I followed the tutorial on http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/human-exon-array-analysis,
Everything works good, finally after running "fs <-
getFirmaScores(firma)", I still did not know how to get the firma
score from the "fs" and correlate it with corresponding exon/probeset.

Can anyone give me a detailed tutorial? Thanks.

messages.author: 1ff63ac4948de366
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] How to use FIRMA
parts:
Hi.

Indeed, the manual is a bit sparse on this. But, you are almost there.

------------
------------ from the web page
------------
Alternative Splicing Analysis (FIRMA)

The FIRMA analysis ONLY works from the PLM based on transcripts.

firma <- FirmaModel(plmTr)
fit(firma, verbose=verbose)
fs <- getFirmaScores(firma)

You can extract the firma scores in the same way as the transcript/
exon estimates with extractDataFrame() or readUnits() applied to fs.
------------
------------
------------

This last comment suggests you can use 'extractDataFrame' or
'readUnits' to get the FIRMA scores into some kind of tabular format
(Note that this may be a very big table or a very big list of tables
for extractDataFrame and readUnits, respectively). For example, for
the first 10 units, you could do:

> exFirma <- extractDataFrame(fs,addNames=TRUE,units=1:10)
> exFirma[,6:ncol(exFirma)]<-log2(exFirma[,6:ncol(exFirma)])

For example:

> exFirma[1:5,1:7]
unitName groupName unit group cell huex_wta_breast_A
huex_wta_breast_B
1 2315251 2315252 1 1 1 0.15717297 -0.22563046
2 2315251 2315253 1 2 2 -0.06614846 0.23234612
3 2315373 2315374 2 1 3 0.61863822 0.06033641
4 2315373 2315375 2 2 4 -0.66929193 -0.50362466
5 2315373 2315376 2 3 5 0.64692440 0.08086550

Here, you can read off the FIRMA scores and the transcript [unitName]
and exon (PSR) [groupName] identifiers.

Cheers,
Mark
